items.q: Why did OpenAI build its own Git server?
items.a: GitHub is **slow and unreliable** when **thousands of agent pushes** land per hour.
The **three-phase commit's repo-wide lock**, which blocks pushes even to **unrelated branches**.

items.q: Which two constraints does Pando relax?
items.a: **Repo-wide consistency** and a **unique minimal pack file** for every client.

items.q: How does Pando store a push?
items.a: It **stores the pack as-is** and later serves a **pack-file URI**; **compaction dedupes** later.

items.q: Why can Pando lock per branch?
items.a: Git objects are **immutable**, so **branches update independently**.

items.q: What is usually the real bottleneck in Git hosting?
items.a: **Disk and CPU**, not the network, so sending **more bytes** can be **faster**.
Written in **Rust** and **formally verified with Lean**.
